macro.title: Global Trade Shifts
macro.body: The ongoing global trade tensions could lead to a shift in trade patterns, with countries seeking alternative markets. This shift may impact the portfolio's holdings in Canadian financial institutions, such as CM.TO and RY.TO, as they may need to adapt to changing trade flows.

macro.body: The ongoing FX volatility, particularly between the USD and CAD, may impact the portfolio's holdings in US-based companies, such as AAPL and QCOM, as they may face exchange rate risks.

risks.title: Leverage Amplification Risk
risks.body: The portfolio's high leverage through FNGU, SPXL, and UDOW may amplify losses in the event of a market downturn.

risks.title: Single-Stock Risk
risks.body: The portfolio's significant holding in NVDA may expose it to single-stock risk, where a decline in NVDA's stock price could negatively impact the portfolio.

risks.title: Cash Drag Risk
risks.body: The portfolio's uninvested RRSP cash may lead to cash drag, where the cash earns a lower return than the overall market.
